# Landing Page Prompt — "ALSO" Bicycle Zine Theme (Fictional Brand)

You are a senior frontend engineer. Build a complete, production-quality landing page implementing the "ALSO" visual system described below. The page must be a single-page marketing site with the sections: Hero, Features (3 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Testimonials, Pricing (3 tiers), FAQ, Final CTA, Footer with secondary links.

## 0. Brand & Copy Rules
- Invent a fictional brand name, product name, and all user-facing copy. Never use the real brand name "ALSO", its logo, trademarks, or product names. All copy must be in English.
- Use placeholder photography descriptions only where imagery is unspecified; do not use lorem ipsum for headings/labels where real copy is expected.

## 1. File Structure & Architecture
- Deliver three separate files: `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline `<script>` blocks beyond a single deferred entry-point reference. No inline `style="..."` attributes anywhere.
- Use one consistent class-naming convention (BEM) across the entire deliverable; never mix conventions.
- All styling lives in `style.css`. HTML must remain semantic and agnostic of visual styling.

## 2. CSS-First Architecture & Tokens
Store all visual tokens in `:root` (and theme classes) using CSS variables. Required tokens:

Colors:
- `--color-cream-paper: #fcf7fa` (page canvas, never pure white)
- `--color-pure-card: #ffffff` (card surfaces, elevated panels, button text on violet fills)
- `--color-ash-mist: #f1f1f1` (tertiary surface, muted dividers)
- `--color-carbon-black: #000000` (primary text, default borders, icon strokes)
- `--color-graphite-input: #212121` (input borders, secondary dark surfaces)
- `--color-obsidian-pill: #1a1a1a` (dark CTA fill)
- `--color-electric-violet: #ac74fc` (primary accent — links, active states, icon highlights, section borders)
- `--color-lilac-pill: #c181ff` (primary CTA fill)
- `--color-deep-plum: #381b5e` (dark violet text variant, deep accent borders)
- `--color-shadow-plum: #48316a` (violet supporting accent; hard shadow color)
- `--color-acid-lime: #b1ff8f` (sparingly used highlight/urgency wash)
- `--color-signal-blue: #1276a9` (outlined action border)

Map these to the standard semantic tokens required by the system: `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`.

Contrast pairing: any light background token must pair with a dark text token, and any dark background token must pair with a light text token, in every theme.

Spacing & shape tokens:
- `--spacing-8: 8px`, `--spacing-16: 16px`, `--spacing-24: 24px`, `--spacing-32: 32px`, `--spacing-40: 40px`, `--spacing-48: 48px`, `--spacing-56: 56px`, `--spacing-64: 64px`, `--spacing-72: 72px`, `--spacing-80: 80px`
- `--radius-sm`, `--radius-md`, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`
- `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`
- `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`

Typography tokens:
- `--font-base` bound to the primary UI font (Google Font substitute: Inter)
- `--font-abccameraplainvariable` (substitute Inter) and `--font-serialc-heavy` (substitute Space Grotesk Bold) via Google Fonts `@import`/`<link>`
- Type scale tokens: `--text-caption` (12px/1.5/-0.6px), `--text-body-sm` (16px/1.2/-0.75px), `--text-subheading` (20px/1.09/-0.9px), `--text-heading-sm` (24px/1.13/-1px), `--text-heading` (32px/1.17/-0.8px), `--text-heading-lg` (44px/1/-0.7px), `--text-display` (60px/0.93/3px)

Shadows:
- Only shadow in the system: `--shadow-subtle: rgb(72, 49, 106) 0px 2px 0px 0px` (hard, 2px, zero blur). Never use blur, never stack shadows, never change the offset.

## 3. Mandatory Dark Mode
- Provide dark mode color tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class selector.
- Background and text CSS variables must switch seamlessly without HTML restructuring.
- Persist user theme choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit.
- Provide a visible toggle control with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label` state.
- Enforce contrast pairing in dark mode as well.

## 4. Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First
- Build all layout structures with Flexbox (`display: flex`).
- Every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless explicitly justified.
- All flex layouts must be mobile-responsive (rows to columns on small viewports); prevent horizontal scrolling.
- Page max-width 1200px, centered. Section gap 80px. Card padding 24px. Element gap 16px. Base unit 8px; never break to 4px or 12px base.

## 5. Framework
- Use Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS driven by Tailwind `@layer`/`@apply`) unless another framework is requested. All utility classes must map back to CSS variables or generic reusable class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).

## 6. Typography & Icons
- Strictly use Google Fonts for text and icons. Include Google Font `<link>`/`@import` tags (Inter, Space Grotesk) and bind to `--font-base`. Use Google Material Symbols/Icons. Forbid raw inline SVGs or local icon files.

## 7. Component Specifications

### Buttons
- Default: Flex layout (`display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;`). Minimum touch target 44x44px.
- Hover: visual shift (brightness/shadow) with `cursor: pointer`.
- Focus: distinct focus ring using CSS variables.
- Active/Pressed: `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- Loading: disables interactions, prevents double-clicks, renders CSS spinner or animated Google Icon without distorting dimensions.
- Disabled: `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- Success/Error: temporary feedback styles driven by `--text-success`/`--text-error`.

Button variants (all pill radius 9999px, all with the single 2px Shadow Plum hard shadow, no blur):
- Primary CTA (Lilac Pill): fill `#c181ff`, text `#000000`, SerialC-Heavy 900 uppercase 14px, tracking 0.05em, padding 20px 40px (12px 20px compact).
- Dark CTA (Obsidian Pill): fill `#1a1a1a`, text `#ffffff`, same type/shadow.
- Green CTA (Acid Lime): fill `#b1ff8f`, text `#000000`, same type/shadow. Used sparingly for urgency.
- Ghost Navigation Link: text-only ABCCameraPlainVariable 400 16px, `#000000`, no underline; active state Electric Violet color or 1px violet bottom border.

### Cards
- Product Card (Hero Showcase): radius 0, no border, no shadow — card IS the image. Image fills card on cream canvas (isolated cutout). Small counter label SerialC-Heavy 14px black at top-left. ~280–340px wide, horizontal flex/grid can extend past viewport.
- Feature Card (Three-Column Grid): radius 12px, full-bleed photographic background, no border/shadow. Title overlay bottom-left ABCCameraPlainVariable 32px black (-0.8px tracking). Compact pill CTA (Lilac Pill) bottom-left below title. Middle card flips to full violet `#ac74fc` fill with white product photography — same structure, inverted palette.
- Story Card (Purple Section): radius 0, no border/shadow. Full Electric Violet `#ac74fc` background as card canvas. Title ABCCameraPlainVariable 20–24px black top-left. Date SerialC-Heavy 14px uppercase tracked top-left below title. Image fills bottom 50%, sharp corners.
- Card states (if interactive): default flex layout with subtle borders/elevation; hover elevation/shadow shift or `transform: translateY(-2px)`; focus-within highlights borders; loading skeleton shimmer; empty state with Google Icon + guidance text.

### Forms & Inputs
- Radius 12px, 1px solid `#212121` border, transparent fill, padding 12px 16px. Text ABCCameraPlainVariable 16px black. Placeholder `#212121` at 50% opacity. Focus: border becomes Electric Violet `#ac74fc`, no glow ring, no shadow.
- States: empty, focused, filled, valid (success border/icon), invalid (error border, red text, error icon), disabled, read-only.
- Structure: flex container wrapping label, input, dedicated error feedback container.

### Modal / Popup
- States: opening, open, loading, success/error, closing (all animated via CSS transitions).
- Centered flex container (`align-items: center`), backdrop overlay, Google Icon close button, keyboard focus trapping, close via Esc or overlay click.

### Top Announcement Bar
- Full-bleed strip, Electric Violet `#ac74fc` or Acid Lime `#b1ff8f` fill (status-dependent), centered text SerialC-Heavy 14px uppercase tracking 0.05em, black text. Tight 10–12px vertical padding. Fixed utility rail above nav.

### Logo Wordmark
- ABCCameraPlainVariable 400 24px, black, letter-spacing 0. Trailing period is part of the wordmark. Top-left of nav bar.

### Rider Counter Tag
- SerialC-Heavy 400 14px, black, comma thousands separator. Stat annotation paired with rider/product cutout.

### Chat Bubble (Bottom-Right)
- 48px circle, Electric Violet `#ac74fc` fill, white chat icon, 1px `#000000` border, no shadow. Fixed bottom-right, 24px margin. Works on both cream and violet sections.

### Section Eyebrow Label
- SerialC-Heavy 400 uppercase 14px, tracking 0.063em, `#000000`, centered or left-aligned. Typographic divider between sections.

### Pagination Control
- Counter "01/03" SerialC-Heavy 14px uppercase at right of section header. Prev/next: 32px circle buttons, 1px `#000000` border, Electric Violet arrow icon, no fill, no shadow, no hover fill change.

## 8. Core UX & Micro-Interactions
- Responsive by default: fluid sizing, responsive breakpoints, no horizontal overflow.
- Smooth animations: CSS transitions on all state changes (`transition: var(--transition-normal)`), respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Accessibility: sufficient contrast in both light and dark modes; never rely solely on color for state; semantic HTML5; correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback.
- Mandatory visual feedback on every click, hover, submission.
- Destructive actions visually distinct in both themes.

## 9. Typographic Rhythm
- ABCCameraPlainVariable is the compressor: negative letter-spacing (-0.05em at body, tightening toward -0.016em at large sizes), collapsing line-heights (1.5 at 12px → 0.93 at 60px).
- SerialC-Heavy is the expander: always uppercase, always positive tracking (0.036–0.063em), always small (12–20px only).
- The two never overlap in size range. Alternate in page rhythm: uppercase SerialC eyebrow → large compressed ABCCamera headline → SerialC button text → ABCCamera body copy.

## 10. Color Discipline
- 2.5-color system: Cream Paper + Carbon Black achromatic backbone; Electric Violet `#ac74fc` is the single chromatic accent in functional roles only. Lilac/Deep Plum/Shadow Plum are violet-family supporters. Acid Lime and Signal Blue are rare utility colors, at most once per page. When in doubt: black, cream, white, and one shade of violet.
- Never use Pure White `#ffffff` as page canvas; always Cream Paper `#fcf7fa`. White reserved for cards/elevated surfaces.
- Never add a second chromatic accent.
- Never use soft drop shadows with blur.

## 11. Imagery
- Product-photography-dominant with cutout/isolated treatment. Riders on bikes/quads/helmets photographed against pure white or cream, placed as full-bleed cutouts with no shadows/borders/context. High-key, bright, slightly desaturated. Lifestyle photography in feature/story cards in bright daylight. No 3D rendering, illustration, or abstract graphics.

## 12. Layout
- Centered max-width ~1200px; content blocks can extend to viewport edges for image grids. Top bar: logo left, nav items centered, utility icon right — no sticky, no mega-menu, no sidebar. Hero: horizontal procession of rider cutouts (can extend past container) → centered headline "One machine for every being." (fictionalize) at 60px → single CTA. Sections stacked vertically with 80px gaps, no visible dividers, separated by eyebrow labels. Feature sections 3-column equal grid. Stories section flips entire viewport to Electric Violet with 3-column card grid + pagination top-right. Navigation purely vertical scrolling; no tabs/anchors except Stories carousel. Density spacious; product grid densest. Footer minimal: wordmark + few links single row.

## 13. Required Sections
Implement all of: Hero, Features (3 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Testimonials, Pricing (3 tiers), FAQ, Final CTA, Footer with secondary links. Use the component rules above for each.

## 14. Deliverables
- `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline scripts beyond a single deferred entry-point reference. No inline CSS. BEM naming throughout. No lorem-ipsum-only submissions where real copy/labels are expected.

Output only the finished code files as specified. Do not include preamble or commentary. Ensure all mandatory rules (CSS-first, dark mode, zero inline CSS, flexbox defaults, Google Fonts/Icons, accessibility, component states) are satisfied. If any requested style change cannot be achieved without adding markup, stop and ask the user instead of silently inserting new HTML. Do not write JavaScript for form validation, popups/modals, or utility/helper functions; if such logic is requested, ask the user how they want it handled. Do not introduce new HTML tags/components/DOM nodes beyond what the existing structure requires. Work only within the existing element/class structure when modifying. All user-facing copy must be in English. Never use the real brand name "ALSO" or its trademarks; invent a fictional brand.
